channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: A Tale of Two Cycles in CPG
item.description: The latest outlook points to flat volumes and cautious shoppers, yet adaptability continues to shape eating patterns and innovation. From bold flavors to store brand gains, brands that balance value and differentiation are positioned to win in 2026.

item.title: Kroger Study Reveals How Shoppers Try New
item.description: New research from Kroger Precision Marketing finds that while shoppers say they’re open to innovation, most stick to familiar habits. Flavor updates, strong in-store visibility and meaningful discounts play an outsized role in convincing consumers to try something new.

item.title: Drake’s Launches Mochaccino Devil Dogs
item.description: Drake’s introduces Mochaccino Devil Dogs, blending cocoa and coffee notes in a café-inspired creme filling. The launch marks the first in a yearlong rotation of new flavors designed to drive limited-time excitement in the snack aisle.

item.title: Tovala Signs Lease for Illinois Facility
item.description: The build-to-suit project marks Brennan Investment Group’s fourth food-sector development, reinforcing demand for mission-critical processing capacity.

item.title: Campbell’s Names Mohit Anand EVP of Snacks
item.description: Anand will oversee long-term growth and margin expansion across Campbell’s snacks portfolio beginning Feb. 23, 2026. He succeeds Elizabeth Duggan, who is departing the company.

item.title: Sanpellegrino Enters Functional Soda Segment
item.description: The launch positions the brand within the growing functional CSD space while maintaining premium, fruit-forward flavor profiles. Strawberry Crema and Cherry Sorbetto roll out nationwide in six-packs.

item.title: ADM: Regenerative Agriculture, Awareness to Action
item.description: The study reveals how this momentum is taking shape and highlights how awareness, motivation and messaging are influencing a new era of purpose-driven purchasing.

item.title: Bluegrass Ingredients: On-Trend Tastes
item.description: Bluegrass Ingredients will serve a wide range of samples that showcase the company’s flavor, texture and functional capabilities across snacks, entrees and desserts.

item.title: Hormel Foods To Sell Whole-Bird Turkey Business
item.description: Hormel Foods has agreed to sell its whole-bird turkey business to Life-Science Innovations, with the deal expected to close by the end of fiscal Q2 2026. The company said the move supports its strategy to reduce exposure to commodity-driven operations and expand value-added proteins.

item.title: Primal Kitchen Debuts Grass-Fed Dressings
item.description: Primal Kitchen is expanding its flagship category with three shelf-stable creamy dressings made from grass-fed dairy. The lineup launches in February at Whole Foods Market, with a broader Spring 2026 rollout planned.
